name: Far Beyond the Doki Doki in Warsaw
source:
A parody dating sim game based on characters from the unpublished comic "Far Beyond the World" by [url=http://razuri-chan.deviantart.com/]Razuri-chan[/url].

The main character of the game is [url=http://mleczdaunhouse.deviantart.com/art/character-sheet-Pilus-FBTW-92241885]Canis Major[/url], a rebellious young man who fights against oppressing government in organized resistance movement. He might be not be the brightest person, though...

Our story begins at boring day when Canis receives a mysterious text message - an invitation to join “Stars of Destiny Dating Program”. He tries to ignore the spam, but it might not be such an easy task...

Game includes 8 Boy/Girl dates, 16 Boy/Boy dates, 1 threesome date and two dates that do not fall into previous categories

Features
- 27 characters 
- 29 endings
- 29 sketch illustrations
- unlockable mode New Game+ with extra character

[Edited from [url=http://kaireen-chan.deviantart.com/art/Far-Beyond-the-Doki-Doki-in-Warsaw-game-download-373841083]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
一款模仿约会模拟游戏，改编自未出版的漫画《遥远的世界》中的角色[url=http://razuri-chan.deviantart.com/]拉苏里酱[/url]。

游戏的主角是[url=http://mleczdaunhouse.deviantart.com/art/character-sheet-Pilus-FBTW-92241885]大犬座[/url]，一个叛逆的年轻人，在有组织的抵抗运动中与压迫政府作斗争。但他可能不是最聪明的人……

我们的故事开始于无聊的一天，卡尼斯收到一条神秘短信——邀请加入“命运之星约会计划”。他试图忽略垃圾邮件，但这可能不是一件容易的事……

游戏包括8个男孩/女孩约会、16个男孩/男孩约会、1个三人约会以及两个不属于之前类别的约会

特点
- 27个字符 
- 29个结局
- 29幅素描插图
- 具有额外角色的可解锁模式新游戏+

[编辑自[url=http://kaireen-chan.deviantart.com/art/Far-Beyond-the-Doki-Doki-in-Warsaw-game-download-373841083]异常艺术[/url]]
